findings.title: Optional key is missing, so a variable the app needs is unset
findings.cause: container api exits because DATABASE_URL is unset: it comes from key url of Secret db-credentials, marked optional, and Secret db-credentials has no key url (it has uri), so the kubelet left the variable out instead of refusing to start the container; its log says: "fatal: DATABASE_URL is not set"; Deployment api has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container api exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 5 times
last lines of container api's log (run that exited)
Secret db-credentials has no key url (it has uri)
evidence.command: kubectl get secret db-credentials -n kd-optional-secret-key-missing -o jsonpath='{.data}'

evidence.what: DATABASE_URL comes from Secret db-credentials key url, optional

findings.fix: Add key url to Secret db-credentials, or point DATABASE_URL at the key it has; and drop optional: true if the app cannot run without it, so that a missing key stops the container with a clear error instead.
